seo.title: Where AI Meets Wharton Expertise.
seo.description: See how the Wharton MBA prepares students to lead in an AI-driven business environment: Michael Roberts’ perspective, AI across the MBA experience, an AI major, student projects, and faculty expertise.

sections.eyebrow: THE WHARTON MBA · AI AND LEADERSHIP
sections.heading: Where AI Meets Wharton Expertise.
sections.text: Start with AI foundations. Build practical solutions. Learn from faculty whose research and work with industry help shape how AI is understood and applied in business.

sections.eyebrow: WHARTON’S APPROACH TO AI IN THE MBA
sections.heading: AI is reshaping business. Wharton prepares leaders for it.
sections.quote: As AI becomes more capable, the deeper question is what we ask of ourselves. A Wharton MBA develops the expertise to recognize what matters, the judgment to question even a convincing answer, and the conviction to take responsibility for a decision no technology can make on our behalf.
sections.role: Vice Dean of the MBA Program
sections.videoTitle: Michael Roberts on Wharton’s approach to AI education

sections.eyebrow: WHAT YOU CAN EXPLORE IN THE WHARTON MBA
sections.heading: Engage with AI at every level.

items.title: AI learning from Pre-Term
items.description: AI learning begins during Pre-Term, and Wharton gives MBA students access to ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and Claude Code. Students follow each instructor’s expectations for AI use.

items.title: AI throughout your MBA, whatever your focus
items.description: Every Wharton MBA student encounters AI, whether or not they pursue the AI major. Faculty bring it into courses across disciplines, team projects, and real corporate work, and open workshops like the Practical AI Workshop Series let any student build hands-on skills.

action.label: See how AI shows up across the MBA

items.title: Go deeper with the AI for Business major
items.description: For students who want to specialize, the Artificial Intelligence for Business major pairs technical fluency with the business, economic, legal, ethical, and societal dimensions of AI.

sections.heading: Rigorous AI learning, put to work by students.
sections.text: Wharton’s academic standards shape what students build. Rigor in the classroom shows up in the ideas they test, the critique they receive, and the work they produce.

items.title: Use AI to deepen your thinking.
items.description: Stronger models can sound more convincing, which makes business expertise and judgment more important. Wharton’s MBA AI programming helps students use AI to support their own learning and analysis, with application, discussion, and problem-solving at the center.

items.title: Build an AI idea through experimentation.
items.description: Wharton profiled Hetvee Marviya, WG’27, building an AI-powered platform that turns current events into personalized comic strips for children. In the Generative AI Studio, students develop their ideas through prototyping, critique, and weekly iteration.

sections.heading:
AI Research.
Business Practice.
MBA Learning.
sections.text: Wharton faculty study how AI changes business and engage with organizations putting it to work. Research, industry experience, and questions from students inform one another for a more robust classroom experience. For MBA prospects, that exchange connects AI learning to the questions businesses are facing right now.

sections.heading: Learn more about AI at Wharton.
sections.text: Explore Wharton’s schoolwide AI teaching and research, and read the MBA’s guidance on school-supported AI tools. The faculty research, student project, and AI learning opportunities featured here link to their Wharton sources.
